jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: We are recruiting US-based architects, Civil Engineers and certified plans examiners to evaluate the output of an AI system that performs automated building-code compliance review on architectural permit applications. The system ingests permit submissions — new builds, alterations, modifications — and issues a compliant or non-compliant determination for each applicable check, drawn from the International Building Code. Every determination comes with a cited code provision and a marked location on the drawing set showing the evidence relied upon. Your job is to tell us where the system got it wrong. You are applying the same judgment you already apply in plan review or permit preparation, to a set of determinations that have already been made. Where the system is correct, you confirm it. Where it is wrong, you correct it and the correction becomes training signal. This is expert review work, not data entry. There is no volume of repetitive clicking to grind through and no generalist labeling pool to compete with — the entire premise of the program is that these judgments cannot be made by anyone without real code expertise. What You’ll Own: Review and correct pass/fail verdicts, written rationales, and citation boxes on PDF plans using the in-tool editing toolkit. jobs.title: Principal Speech Data Linguist
jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: As speech and audio models get better, the human role gets harder, not easier — it moves from producing transcripts to defining what a correct one is, adjudicating the cases models still get wrong, and designing the human-in-the-loop workflows that keep improving them. Innodata runs high-volume segmentation and transcription workflows for the customers and frontier labs building these models, and we are hiring a principal-level linguist to own the linguistic standards and quality behind that work — today, and as the workflows evolve alongside the models over the next two years. This is the applied-expert counterpart to our Speech & Audio Research Scientist. Your leverage is scientific judgment about data: deciding what is worth capturing in the real world versus generating in simulation, how to weight a training mix across embodiments and sensors, and how to measure whether a policy will hold up outside the lab. Your conclusions will shape what our partners collect next. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing speech and audio models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Video & Multimodal
jobs.description_text: Scope of the Role: Video is where multimodal models are weakest and hardest to grade. Temporal reasoning, long-form understanding, grounding events in time, and holding audio, video, and text together do not fall out of image benchmarks — and the evaluations for them are still immature. Closing that gap is gated as much by how we design data and evaluation as by architecture. Innodata builds that data and those evaluations for the customers and frontier labs advancing video and multimodal models, and we are hiring a Research Scientist to own the science behind it. You will partner directly with the customers and frontier labs building video understanding, video-language, and video-generation models, as interested in the data behind them as in the models themselves. Video spans two model families judged in completely different ways: models that understand video — answering questions, localizing events, grounding language in time — where the question is whether the answer is correct; and models that generate it, where fidelity, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility matter and no automatic metric is settled. You own the evaluation science for both, and knowing when model-based scoring can stand in for a human versus when it can't. Your conclusions shape what our partners measure and collect next. What You’ll Own: You will define how Innodata designs, structures, and evaluates video data for video and multimodal models, and you will validate those choices experimentally.

Reporting to the CFO, this leader will own the financial plan, forecasting, and operating metrics that guide decisions across the business. They will partner closely with functional leaders to turn financial and operational data into clear insights, strengthen accountability, and help drive strategic decisions. This is a pivotal role at a defining stage for the company. The Director, FP&A will develop the processes, systems, and team needed to operate at the highest standards, including more forecasting and operational cadence, board and investor materials, and support to fundraising. The ideal candidate combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution, communicates complex issues simply, and has helped a high-growth company scale through the different phases of growth. Responsibilities Lead the company’s annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, monthly financial performance reviews, and long-range financial planning. The Director of Tax will serve as the company’s senior tax advisor, partnering with Finance, Accounting, Legal, Strategy, Business Development, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and other teams to integrate tax considerations into business decisions, financial planning, new ventures, geographic expansion, transactions, and capital investment. The role will be highly hands-on initially and will build the processes, systems, controls, and team required as Kairos transitions from a development-stage company to a scaled industrial enterprise and moves toward public-company standards. This is not a narrow compliance role. The Director of Tax will be a value-creation leader and strategic business partner—converting Kairos’ innovation and capital investment into cash benefits, integrating tax into major decisions, and building the infrastructure, controls, systems, and team required for scale and future public-market access.
